title: CPU-reproducible global-bound population programming-error HWA for the IBM-OM crossbar
hypothesis: Replacing fixed repaired-Array-A support plus unconditional additive write noise with global q bounds and a fresh healthy, accepted, target-conditioned OM P&V residual draw on every minibatch will improve fixed-final exact-master deployment on fresh B-D arrays. Population HWA is beneficial over fixed-A stochastic HWA within a deployment defect policy only if pooled apparent accuracy improves by at least 1.0 percentage point, teacher-to-student KL decreases, at least two of three assignment means improve, and no assignment mean falls by more than 2.0 points. Published corrupt devices remain a material deployment problem if the byte-identical population-HWA master loses at least 5.0 pooled accuracy points from repaired to published B-D, all three assignment differences are negative, and pooled KL increases.
motivation: The completed crossed long-HWA study showed that removing Array A's fixed defect map helps transfer to published B-D, but the repaired-A control still binds every logical coordinate to A's exact per-cell support and injects only the OM preset's unconditional additive apparent write noise. IBM-style inference HWA uses one shared normalized weight range and generic programming-error draws rather than one named chip or failure map. This study introduces that missing architecture-matched control while leaving published failures and corrupt identities for exact P&V deployment. It does not assert parity with IBM's PCM-specific programming-error, read-noise, scaling, or peripheral model. The v1 diagnostic attempt validated all run artifacts but failed its historical fixed-master reproduction criterion because the earlier one-thread CPU math environment had not been encoded. This v2 study makes that execution condition explicit and fail-closed in every config before repeating any scientific comparison.

arms.description: Existing fixed repaired-A support and additive-write-noise HWA control, exact-master P&V onto repaired B-D.
Global-bound healthy-population accepted-endpoint HWA, exact-master P&V onto repaired B-D.
Same fixed repaired-A HWA control, exact-master P&V onto published-corrupt B-D.
The same population-HWA master contract, exact-master P&V onto published-corrupt B-D.

completion_criteria: All four configs complete exactly once. They use the same frozen bias-free 784-50-10 teacher, data split, minibatch order, full 55000-example ten-epoch budget, 34380 Adam steps, teacher-KL objective, logical rates [0.0001,0.0001], fixed-final selection, exact-master handoff, source assignment A=87004, fresh assignments B-D=87005-87007, and four matched endpoint streams per assignment.

Every config requires OMP_NUM_THREADS=1, MKL_NUM_THREADS=1, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1, and NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1. Runtime must fail closed on any missing or different value, verify torch intra-op threads equal one, and record the required and observed thread contract in the resolved config and summary.

The population arms pin data/ibm_reram_om_pv128_hwa_v1.json at SHA-256 3030e04d6205dc90d0894ac453d2c1c522dffdc004f69b9c6ab7eaf7ef4b8ba3. They compile only the adequate adaptive__lower_to_target__tau_step_0.5 accepted non-corrupt residual rows from its continuous endpoint branch; the branch is cap 128, lower-to-target, and uses apparent-x tolerance 0.023725.

Population HWA clips only the FP32 master to global q in [-1,1]. Each minibatch independently samples one full-array target-conditioned residual realization in x=(q+1)/2, converts it to q, applies an epoch-linear strength of 0.1 through 1.0, and uses that same apparent realization for forward and identity-STE backward. It never consumes source-A per-cell bounds, references, update increments, corruption mask, hidden persistent endpoints, or assignment seed.

The two population configs reproduce byte-identical fixed-final master tensors, optimizer states, programming-error RNG receipts, and first-epoch training cohorts before deployment. They differ only by the explicit B-D transfer corruption policy. The fixed-A pair likewise reproduces the previously pinned repaired-A master SHA-256 8a2f31abf08e9eafcb70cb96ae1ae20af5ebb05eb2cd8de6383d9a46c0726cbc.

Every population epoch reports strength, full-array draw count, scalar count, unscaled and applied q-error moments, out-of-global-range apparent values, residual sequence digest, and RNG states. The model bundle is a registered input artifact, and the off-chip checkpoint records its compiled-model fingerprint and replay cursor.

Every source and transfer endpoint reports requested master, per-array support and codebook diagnostics, apparent and hidden-persistent post-P&V states, defect counts, acceptance, exhaustion, saturation, pulse/read totals, state and prediction hashes, accuracy, agreement, and teacher KL. Apparent state is the network forward; persistent state remains a programming diagnostic.

B-D assignment means, not the four repeated writes within an assignment, are the fresh-array units. The healthy-HWA versus fixed-A decision is made separately for repaired and published deployment. The repaired-versus-published corruption decision uses the byte-identical population master and paired assignment/endpoint streams.

This remains exploratory AIHWKit-1.1.0 OM-preset evidence on 1000 test examples. The population error fit is model-based rather than raw measured-device evidence; it omits IBM's PCM-specific error law, inference read noise, trainable output scales and input ranges, converters, IR drop, retention, and native RNG parity. Its adaptive fitted HWA controller also differs from the exact deployment's repeated one-pulse verify controller, which must be reported as a model mismatch rather than hidden.
analysis_plan: Fail closed unless configs, executable source, teacher, data order, required and observed one-thread CPU contract, bundle hash and embedded source provenance, optimizer steps, model fingerprints, RNG receipts, exact-master hashes, A-D population fingerprints, target policies, endpoint pairing, and P&V accounting satisfy the completion criteria.

First verify that population training is independent of fixed A: initial realized q must equal the global master rather than clamp(master,A support), source-A identity must be absent from the programming-error seed derivation, and the two population arms must have identical fixed-final training artifacts before deployment.

For repaired B-D and published B-D separately, compare population HWA against fixed repaired-A stochastic HWA using each B/C/D apparent-accuracy and KL mean plus pooled twelve-write summaries. Apply the predeclared +1-point, lower-KL, two-of-three, and no-worse-than-2-point conjunction without post-hoc checkpoint selection.

Within population HWA, pair repaired and published outcomes by assignment and endpoint seed. Report the defect-count change, apparent and persistent accuracy penalty, KL change, acceptance/exhaustion/saturation changes, and apply the predeclared 5-point/all-three/larger-KL materiality gate.

Report source A only as a deployment diagnostic; do not use it as an independent population replicate. Keep programming residuals, exact target reachability, verify-window intersection, apparent acceptance, hidden persistent state, and corrupt identity separate.

Compare the population master descriptively against matched no-HWA results from the completed long-HWA exact-P&V study only after target fingerprints and endpoint hashes match. If population HWA still fails on repaired arrays, attribute that to the tested endpoint-model/training protocol rather than infer a general need for on-chip recovery. If repaired transfer succeeds but published transfer fails, test defect-aware mapping or spare resources before introducing a frozen-versus-on-chip recovery fork.
